best_match.fbbt_definition: Generalizations about fasciculation are safe here. But the 4 PNs have still not been analyzed: DA4m, DC4, VP2, and VL1. See Yu et al. (2010) for details. An adult uniglomerular antennal lobe projection neuron that is derived from the neuroblast ALad1 (FBbt:00067346). All of these neurons have axons that fasciculate with the medial antennal lobe tract (mALT) and except for V adPN neurons, innervate the mushroom body calyx (via a collateral) and the lateral horn.

justification: DC3 and VA1d PNs together (not separated in adults): the common parent of DC3 adPN and VA1d adPN. Mature term from the pharate adult stage (curator). Lineage: the authors' per-cell `lineage` for this type in the main analysis: adPN 33, vPN 1, lPN 1.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00100368 adult uniglomerular antennal lobe projection neuron adPN (broad match).
